title: Polynomial-space Leray step of simultaneous dimension induction
statement:
For algebraically closed K, d=n+2, assume all affine bounds over all fields in dimensions less than d, with every field cohomological bound. Every positively annihilated sheaf M on A^d_K has H^q(M)=0 for q>d. Use torsion cohomological dimension as in [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd], the strict localization as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] when it occurs, and Krull dimension as in [def-kun-dimension]. The following verbatim Lean statement specifies all universes, hypotheses, scalar structures, sheaves and degrees:

theorem subsingleton_H_polynomial_of_lowerDimension
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (n : ℕ)
    (hIH : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (m c : ℕ), m < n + 2 →
      (Spec (.of L)).HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE c →
      ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of L))
        [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a],
        topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (m : WithBot ℕ∞) →
          X.HasTorsionCohomologicalDimensionLE (m + c))
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 2)) K))).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : N • 𝟙 M = 0)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : n + 2 < q) : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H M q)

source.place: Polynomial projection and final Leray diagonal

proof.text: Use the first-variable polynomial projection. Additivity preserves its annihilator through ordinary right derived functors. On a diagonal p+r=q>d, the base affine bound d-1 kills r=0,1.

For r>=2 weighted projection support kills stalks above d-r. If r>d the whole sheaf is zero by geometric conservativity. Otherwise every closed affine subscheme of dimension at most d-r satisfies the required bound by hIH; apply the bounded-support cohomology theorem.
All diagonal terms vanish. LowerStar is right adjoint to exact inverse image, so the Grothendieck acyclicity condition holds. Apply diagonal vanishing and the direct-image/global-sections comparison.
